description: Verify a sealed registration's receipt over the statement you registered, with @forestrie/mcp-verify's verifier, and return its four-question answers unaltered. By default the trust root is this server's own log key, the root of your data log; verifying never creates a key. Pass a known accumulator (from @forestrie/mcp-resolve's fetch_accumulator) to use a root that can also answer split-view.

contentHash.description: the content hash register_statement returned (64 lowercase hex)

anyOf.description: filesystem path, read by the stdio adapter

knownAccumulator.description: optional: a known accumulator (e.g. from @forestrie/mcp-resolve's fetch_accumulator) to verify against instead of this server's own log key — { b64 } | { base64 } | { path }

name: verify_registration
title: Verify a registration's receipt
